meta.title: Turn an old tablet into a family wall display | Daili
meta.description: Hang an old tablet in the kitchen and show your family's week, meals and lists. Simple steps for iPad, Android, Fire, Windows, Mac and Raspberry Pi.

hero.h1: Give an old tablet a new job.
hero.intro: Hang it in the kitchen or hallway. It shows your family's week, meals, lists and habits, and everyone can tick things off as they walk past. Free, with the tablet you already own.

ui.guessed: You seem to be on this kind of device, so we opened its steps. Setting up another one? Pick it in the list.

devices.name: iPad
devices.lead: Works on every iPad from 2017 on. An iPad cannot open a page by itself, so after a power cut it needs one tap.

jobs.title: Connect the screen
steps: In **Safari**, open **app.daili.app/board/pair**. Tap **Share → Add to Home Screen → Add**.
Close Safari and open the new **Daili** icon. If you see the sign-in page, tap **Connect a screen with a code**.
In the Daili app on your phone: **Settings → Wall display → Connect a screen**. Type the code or scan the QR code. Only parents can do this.
Give the screen a name, for example "Kitchen", and tap **Approve**. The board opens after a few seconds.

extra.tip: **Connect inside the icon, not in Safari.** The icon keeps its own saved data.

jobs.title: Full screen and child lock
steps: **Settings → Accessibility → Guided Access**: switch it on.
**Passcode Settings → Set Guided Access Passcode**. Pick a code the children do not know.
Open the Daili icon, triple-click the Home button (or the top button) and tap **Start**.

extra.note: The Home Screen icon is already full screen. Guided Access keeps the iPad inside Daili until you triple-click and enter the code.

jobs.title: Keep the screen on
steps: **Settings → Display & Brightness → Auto-Lock → Never**.
**Settings → Accessibility → Guided Access → Display Auto-Lock → Never**.

jobs.title: After a restart
steps: Turn off automatic installs: **Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic Updates**. An update restarts the iPad at night.
After a restart or power cut: unlock, tap the Daili icon, triple-click, tap **Start**.

jobs.title: Protect the battery
steps: Newer iPads (iPad Pro M4, iPad Air M2, iPad mini A17 Pro, iPad A16 and later): **Settings → Battery → Battery Health → 80% Limit**.
Older iPads have no limit. Use a timer plug, see "Battery and safety" below.

devices.name: Android tablet
devices.lead: The best way is the Fully Kiosk Browser app. It was made for wall tablets and is the only way to start by itself after a restart.

jobs.title: Connect the screen
steps: Install **Fully Kiosk Browser** from Google Play.
On first start, type the Start URL: **https://app.daili.app/board**. A 6-digit code and a QR code appear.
In the Daili app on your phone: **Settings → Wall display → Connect a screen**. Type the code or scan the QR code. Only parents can do this.
Give the screen a name, for example "Kitchen", and tap **Approve**. The board opens after a few seconds.

extra.tip: **Just trying it out?** Chrome works too: open app.daili.app/board/pair, connect, then ⋮ → Add to Home screen → Install.

jobs.title: Full screen and child lock
steps: Swipe in from the left edge and tap **Settings**.
**Toolbars and Appearance**: switch full screen on.
**Kiosk Mode** (paid): **Enable Kiosk Mode** and set a **Kiosk Mode PIN**. To leave, tap fast 7 times and enter the PIN.

jobs.title: Keep the screen on
steps: **Device Management → Keep Screen On**: on.
Optional: **Motion Detection** wakes the screen when someone walks by, and **Screen Off Timer** lets it rest at night.
In the tablet settings, switch battery saver off.

jobs.title: Start by itself
steps: **Device Management → Launch on Boot**: on.
**Web Auto Reload**: reload when the network reconnects.
Tablet settings: **Security → Screen lock → None**, so a restart goes straight to the board.

extra.tip: Leave every "clear cache" or "delete web storage" option **off**. They disconnect the screen.

jobs.title: Protect the battery
steps: Samsung: **Settings → Battery → Battery protection → Maximum → 80 %**.
Other brands: search Settings for "charge" or "protect".
Nothing there? Use a timer plug, see "Battery and safety" below.

devices.name: Amazon Fire tablet
devices.lead: A Fire tablet works with its own Silk browser. That is the simple way. Older Fire tablets from 2015 to 2017 are too old.

jobs.title: Connect the screen
steps: On the Fire tablet, open **Silk** and go to **app.daili.app/board/pair**. A 6-digit code and a QR code appear.
In the Daili app on your phone: **Settings → Wall display → Connect a screen**. Type the code or scan the QR code. Only parents can do this.
Give the screen a name, for example "Kitchen", and tap **Approve**. The board opens after a few seconds.

jobs.title: Full screen
steps: Tap the board once. It goes full screen.

extra.note: Want a child lock? Install Fully Kiosk Browser from fully-kiosk.com and follow the Android steps. Its maker warns that a Fire update can break the lock.

jobs.title: Keep the screen on
steps: **Settings → Display → Display Sleep → Never** (or the longest time).
No "Never"? **Settings → Device Options → About Fire Tablet**: tap "Serial Number" 7 times. Then **Developer Options → Stay awake**.

jobs.title: After a restart
steps: Switch the lock-screen passcode off: **Settings → Security & Privacy**.
After a restart: swipe to unlock and open Silk. The board comes back.

jobs.title: Protect the battery
steps: Fire tablets have no charge limit. Use a timer plug, see "Battery and safety" below.

devices.name: Windows
devices.lead: Works on Windows 10 and 11, Home and Pro. Windows signs in by itself and opens Daili full screen.

jobs.title: Connect the screen
steps: On the device, open **Microsoft Edge** and go to **app.daili.app/board/pair**. A 6-digit code and a QR code appear.
In the Daili app on your phone: **Settings → Wall display → Connect a screen**. Type the code or scan the QR code. Only parents can do this.
Give the screen a name, for example "Kitchen", and tap **Approve**. The board opens after a few seconds.

jobs.title: Full screen
steps: Press **Windows + R**, type `shell:startup`, press Enter. A folder opens.
Right-click in the folder → **New → Shortcut**. Paste this line as the location:

extra.note: Name it "Daili board". Double-click it to test. Leave with **Alt + F4**.

jobs.title: Keep the screen on
steps: **Settings → System → Power**: set "turn off my screen" and "sleep" to **Never** when plugged in.
Laptop: **Control Panel → Power Options → Choose what closing the lid does → Do nothing**.
**Settings → System → Notifications**: switch them off.

jobs.title: Start by itself
steps: **Settings → Accounts → Sign-in options**: turn off "Require Windows Hello sign-in for Microsoft accounts". Restart once.
Press **Windows + R**, type `netplwiz`, press Enter.
Remove the tick at "Users must enter a user name and password", click OK, type the password twice.

extra.note: The shortcut from step 2 is in the Startup folder, so Daili opens after every sign-in.

jobs.title: Protect the battery
steps: Look for a charge limit in the maker's app (Lenovo Vantage, ASUS, Acer Care Center, Surface).
Nothing there? Use a timer plug, see "Battery and safety" below.
Mini PC: nothing to do, it has no battery.

devices.name: Raspberry Pi / Linux
devices.lead: The best build-it-yourself wall display. No battery, little power, and it starts by itself when the power comes back.

jobs.title: Connect the screen
steps: On the Pi, open **Chromium** and go to **app.daili.app/board/pair**. A 6-digit code and a QR code appear.
In the Daili app on your phone: **Settings → Wall display → Connect a screen**. Type the code or scan the QR code. Only parents can do this.
Give the screen a name, for example "Kitchen", and tap **Approve**. The board opens after a few seconds.

jobs.title: Full screen and autostart
steps: Open a terminal and run the two lines below. An empty file opens.
Paste the third line into the file. Save with Ctrl + O, Enter, then Ctrl + X.

jobs.title: Keep the screen on
steps: Run `sudo raspi-config`.
**Display Options → Screen Blanking → No**.

jobs.title: Start by itself
steps: In `raspi-config`: **System Options → Boot / Auto Login → Desktop Autologin**.
Run `sudo reboot`. The Pi starts and shows the board.

extra.note: Other Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora): set Screen Blank to Never, switch on Automatic Login, and add the same Chromium line as a startup program.

jobs.title: Protect the battery
steps: Nothing to do. A Pi has no battery.

devices.name: Mac
devices.lead: An old iMac makes a big, bright family screen. It is for looking, because a Mac has no touch screen.

jobs.title: Connect the screen
steps: On the Mac, open **Chrome** and go to **app.daili.app/board/pair**. A 6-digit code and a QR code appear.
In the Daili app on your phone: **Settings → Wall display → Connect a screen**. Type the code or scan the QR code. Only parents can do this.
Give the screen a name, for example "Kitchen", and tap **Approve**. The board opens after a few seconds.

jobs.title: Full screen
steps: In Chrome: **⋮ → Cast, save, and share → Install page as app**.
Open the Daili app from the Dock and click the board once.

jobs.title: Keep the screen on
steps: **System Settings → Lock Screen**: set "Turn display off when inactive" and "Start Screen Saver" to **Never**.

jobs.title: Start by itself
steps: **System Settings → General → Login Items**: add the Daili app.
**System Settings → Users & Groups → Automatically log in as**: pick the user.
iMac or Mac mini: **Energy → Start up automatically after a power failure**.

jobs.title: Protect the battery
steps: MacBook: **System Settings → Battery → Battery Health → Optimized Battery Charging**: on.
iMac and Mac mini have no battery.

devices.name: Chromebook
devices.lead: Works well as a screen on a shelf or sideboard. After a restart you sign in once.

jobs.title: Connect the screen
steps: On the Chromebook, open **Chrome** and go to **app.daili.app/board/pair**. A 6-digit code and a QR code appear.
In the Daili app on your phone: **Settings → Wall display → Connect a screen**. Type the code or scan the QR code. Only parents can do this.
Give the screen a name, for example "Kitchen", and tap **Approve**. The board opens after a few seconds.

jobs.title: Full screen
steps: Press the full-screen key (the rectangle in the top row).

jobs.title: Keep the screen on
steps: **Settings → Device → Power**: "While charging" → **Keep display on**.
Switch "Sleep when cover is closed" off.

jobs.title: After a restart
steps: **Settings → On startup → Continue where you left off**.
After a restart: sign in. The board opens again.

jobs.title: Protect the battery
steps: Use a timer plug, see "Battery and safety" below.

devices.name: TV or other
devices.sub: Fire TV, Android TV, old phone
devices.lead: A TV can show the board, but you cannot tap it. Some devices cannot show it at all.

jobs.title: Connect the screen
steps: On the TV, open **the browser (Silk on Fire TV)** and go to **app.daili.app/board/pair**. A 6-digit code and a QR code appear.
In the Daili app on your phone: **Settings → Wall display → Connect a screen**. Type the code or scan the QR code. Only parents can do this.
Give the screen a name, for example "Kitchen", and tap **Approve**. The board opens after a few seconds.

jobs.title: What works
steps: **Fire TV, Android TV:** the board shows in the browser. No ticking, no adding.
**Old phone:** follow the iPad or Android steps. Nice on the fridge.
**TRMNL e-paper display:** Daili has its own plugin on trmnl.com.

jobs.title: What does not work
steps: Google Nest Hub, Amazon Echo Show and Apple TV cannot show the board.
Tablets older than about 2016 show a broken page or a security warning.

jobs.title: Careful with OLED TVs
steps: Do not leave the board on an OLED TV for hours. A picture that never moves can burn into the screen.

hangUp.title: Now hang it up
items: Pick a place everyone walks past, at eye height for the children.
Check the Wi-Fi at that spot before you drill.
Set quiet hours in Daili. The board turns dark at night by itself.
Use the tablet only for Daili. Switch sound and notifications off.

safety.title: Battery and safety
items: **Use the charge limit** if your device has one. 80 % is ideal.
**No charge limit?** Use a timer plug or smart plug. Let it charge for about one hour, two or three times a day.
**Keep it cool.** No direct sun, and not above the cooker, the kettle or a heater.
**Lower the brightness.** Half is enough indoors.
**Check it once a month.** If the back bulges, the screen lifts or the case is hot, stop using it and bring it to a recycling point.

items.q: The screen turns off after a few minutes
items.a: Set the screen timeout (iPad: Auto-Lock) to Never, as in step 3 for your device. Switch battery saver off.

items.q: The board shows a code again
items.a: The browser's saved data was cleared, or the board was opened in another browser or a private window. Connect it again and always open it the same way.
A parent removed the screen, or the parent who connected it left the family. A parent can connect it again.

items.q: A security warning or a broken page
items.a: The device or its browser is too old. Update the browser. On an old Android tablet, try Firefox.
The Wi-Fi is weak at that spot, or the device lets Wi-Fi sleep. Move the router closer or switch Wi-Fi power saving off.

items.q: How do I leave the board?
items.a: Press and hold **Hold to leave** for two seconds. If you locked the device (Guided Access, kiosk mode, app pinning), end that lock first.

items.q: The tablet was lost or sold
items.a: In the Daili app: Settings → Wall display → Wall screens → Remove. It stops showing your family at once.
